boss_phases.behavior: Slow charges and slams, 2 vent plumes per slam, single conduit active
Faster charges, 3 vent plumes, temple begins flooding, two conduits active
Enraged, 4 vent plumes, oxygen drain accelerates, all conduits active, shorter stagger windows

combat_loop: 1) EXPLORE the flooded coral nave and locate glowing Coral Thermal Conduits. 2) ACTIVATE a conduit to begin siphoning a deep-sea thermal current (channeled, interruptible). 3) The Leviathan Abyssal Warden charges and slams, spawning Hydrothermal Vent Plumes (radius 6.5) that deal burn damage — dodge out of the plume ring. 4) Once a current is fully siphoned, WEAVE it into a hydro-barrier that hardens around the Warden, staggering it and exposing its brine-soft core. 5) BURST the exposed core with Thermal Current Siphon (45 dmg per pulse) during the stagger window. 6) Repeat across three phases as the Warden floods the temple and adds more vent plumes; manage oxygen and current charges to survive.

environment.fog: Dense volumetric fog, deep blue-green, high density for depth occlusion
environment.lighting: Low ambient teal, volumetric god-rays through collapsed ceiling, emissive coral and vent glow
environment.mood: Bioluminescent dread, cathedral grandeur drowned in pressure and cold

lose_condition: Player oxygen reaches 0 or player HP reaches 0.
npc_dialogue_preview: The Warden's hide is brine-hardened, diver. You cannot cut it — but the vents below still remember the sun's fire. Siphon the thermal currents, weave them into a hydro-barrier, and let the deep itself turn against its warden.
prompt_directive: Create an ancient sunken coral temple in the Abyssal Trenches where players manipulate deep-sea thermal currents into a hydro-barrier to defeat the Leviathan Abyssal Warden.
win_condition: Reduce Leviathan Abyssal Warden HP from 2400 to 0 across three phases using hydro-barrier staggers and Thermal Current Siphon bursts.
zone_title: The Sunken Coral Cathedral of the Abyssal Trenches
